items.title: NASA weighs more Boeing Starliner missions despite troubled test flight - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- NASA and Boeing are discussing using the Starliner spacecraft for 10 or more new missions to low-Earth orbit, despite technical failures during its troubled 2024 crewed test flight, the Wall Street Journal reported exclusively.

items.title: NASA Explores New Missions With Boeing’s Troubled Starliner Spacecraft
items.summary: The talks are a turnaround for a ship that posed risks to crew members on a 2024 flight to the International Space Station.

items.title: Can A Faster Factory Lift Boeing Stock?
items.summary: Boeing (BA) stock is down about 8% over the past year and trades about 22% below its 52-week high. Inside the factories the picture reads differently: the company is delivering airplanes at a pace it has not managed since 2018, against a record order book. The upside case rests on a clear assumption: translating that delivery pace into positive free cash flow.

items.title: Boeing Starliner May Get a Bigger NASA Role Despite Leaving Crew Behind As SpaceX Looks Past Dragon, Says Report
items.summary: NASA and Boeing are discussing 10 or more additional Starliner flights in the years ahead, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: Boeing’s $36.2 Billion Korean Air Deal Won’t Help Earnings Until the 2030s
items.summary: Korean Air just signed a $36.2 billion Boeing commitment stretching well into the next decade, but a record backlog and blockbuster headline numbers tell only part of the story for a manufacturer still racing to prove it can actually deliver.
